meta.name: bioservices
meta.description: Unified Python interface to 40+ bioinformatics services. Use when querying multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) in a single workflow with consistent API. Best for cross-database analysis, ID mapping across services. For quick single-database lookups use gget; for sequence/file manipulation use biopython.

copy.tagline_en: Query multiple bio databases with a unified API
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to query multiple bioinformatics databases in one workflow

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 Python 调用约40个生物信息学服务（UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等），完成蛋白质检索、通路分析、化合物搜索、跨库 ID 映射和 BLAST 比对，并把结果整合到同一流程。
howto.when: 当用户要求跨多个数据库（如 UniProt、KEGG、ChEMBL 等）查询或整合数据、做 ID 映射、通路分析或 BLAST 比对时。单库快速查询请用 gget，序列/文件处理用 biopython。

say.text: 查 UniProt 的 P43403，取序列并映射到 KEGG ID。
say.note: 会调用 bioservices 执行检索与 ID 映射。

say.text: 分析 KEGG hsa04660 通路，提取蛋白质相互作用。
say.note: 会用 parse_kgml_pathway 解析通路数据。

say.text: 用 BLAST 比对这段蛋白序列，数据库选 uniprotkb。
say.note: 需要先设置 NCBI_EMAIL 邮箱。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use Python to access ~40 bioinformatics services (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL, Reactome) for protein retrieval, pathway analysis, compound search, cross-database ID mapping, and BLAST, integrating results in one workflow.
howto.when_en: When the user asks to query or integrate data across multiple databases (UniProt, KEGG, ChEMBL), map IDs, analyze pathways, or run BLAST. For quick single-db lookups use gget; for sequence/file handling use biopython.

say_en.text: Look up UniProt P43403, get its sequence, and map it to a KEGG ID.
say_en.note: Runs retrieval and ID mapping via bioservices.

say_en.text: Analyze KEGG pathway hsa04660 and extract protein interactions.
say_en.note: Parses KGML to get pathway relations.

say_en.text: Run BLAST on this protein sequence against uniprotkb.
